lines.text: One-sentence recommendation. Done. Now — how do I package it so Priya actually reads it?
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: First version — I went big. Nineteen slides. Every chart, every alternative, every caveat. I was proud of it.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Gave it to Priya. She opened it. Scrolled to slide three. Closed the tab.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: She looked at me — Avery, I have seven minutes before my next meeting. What do you want me to do?
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: VPs don't read. They skim.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: This wasn't a content problem. It was a container problem.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: The shape I needed was a one-pager. Not a shorter deck — a completely different artifact.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Five parts. Headline finding. Recommendation. Supporting chart. Risk. Ask.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Everything Priya needs to decide. Nothing else.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: I took the same data — and poured it into the template. Same information. Completely different shape.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Nineteen slides became half a page.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Priya read it in the elevator. Tapped my shoulder at the next meeting — do it.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Engineers shipped the revert. Tickets dropped 35 percent. Two million saved. Nobody got laid off.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: At Airbnb — they'll ask for a one-pager. They mean one page.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Use the template. Headline. Recommendation. Chart. Risk. Ask. Nothing else.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Your turn.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Three situations. Pick the format — and what goes in it.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Nice. Now — you finish the project.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: You've got your findings and your recommendation from earlier. Jordan needs it as a one-pager by end of day.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Use Claude to reshape everything into the template. I'll be watching.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Give Claude your raw content. Ask it to reformat into the five-part template.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Then iterate — put the recommendation up top, cut anything not decision-relevant.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Check it against three boxes — recommendation visible in ten seconds, fits one page, skimmable.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: All three green — send it back.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: That's the project. Same data I had on Day 1. Completely different container. The container was the whole fight.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Six chapters. From brief to one-pager. That's the playbook.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: And that's exactly the project Airbnb is handing interns this summer. Different platform, same shape. You already know the playbook. Let's go meet them.
lines.speaker: avery
